Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly navigate to the requested URL (https://www.footballdb.com/teams/nfl/st-louis-rams) in Step 4. Instead of loading the St. Louis Rams page, it loaded the Los Angeles Rams page (https://www.footballdb.com/teams/nfl/los-angeles-rams), as evidenced by the page title "Los Angeles Rams" and the visible content showing the 2025 season and current coach Sean McVay. This navigation error prevented the agent from gathering the specific historical data needed to corroborate the 1999 record, despite the Planner's explicit instruction to visit the St. Louis Rams page. This was the first instance where the agent's action directly contradicted its own instructions and failed to retrieve the intended data source.
